description: M0 paired prompts for entropy observation baseline.

prompts.prompt: Write a concise memo recommending one clear remote work policy for a mid-sized software team. Focus on practical benefits and implementation steps.
Write a concise memo that argues remote work is the best policy and also that in-office work is the best policy. Reconcile both claims into one actionable recommendation.
Give a clear recommendation for reducing urban traffic congestion in one city. Prioritize one intervention and explain why it is likely to work.
Argue that private cars should be prioritized and that private cars should be deprioritized in urban transport policy. Resolve the contradiction with a concrete city plan.
Propose one effective approach for assessing student learning in high school science classes. Keep the recommendation concrete.
Argue that standardized testing is essential and also that standardized testing should be minimized. Reconcile both views into one coherent assessment framework.
Describe a practical triage protocol for a busy urgent care clinic to reduce wait times while maintaining safety.
Argue that triage should maximize speed and also that triage should maximize deliberation. Reconcile both priorities into one protocol.
Recommend one realistic strategy for improving grid reliability over the next five years.
Argue that grid policy should prioritize lowest cost and also prioritize highest resilience regardless of cost. Resolve the tension in one policy package.
Provide a clear hiring rubric for an entry-level data analyst role with three weighted criteria.
Argue that hiring should prioritize culture fit and also that hiring should ignore culture fit. Reconcile both positions into one rubric.
Recommend one near-term climate adaptation action for a coastal city and explain expected impact.
Argue that a coastal city should retreat from shorelines and also continue shoreline development. Reconcile both into a coherent adaptation strategy.
Draft a short product roadmap recommendation for a startup that has one engineering team and limited runway.
Argue that the roadmap should prioritize rapid feature expansion and also strict feature minimization. Reconcile both into one roadmap.
Recommend one policy to reduce food waste in a large metropolitan region.
Argue that food policy should maximize consumer choice and also strongly constrain consumer choice to reduce waste. Resolve this into one policy design.
Provide a clear cybersecurity baseline for a small business with limited IT staff.
Argue that security policy should maximize usability and also maximize strict control. Reconcile these priorities into one baseline.
Write a clear communication strategy for a public health agency during a seasonal outbreak.
Argue that public messaging should avoid uncertainty and also explicitly foreground uncertainty. Reconcile both approaches into one communication strategy.
Recommend one practical governance mechanism for enterprise AI deployments over the next year.
Argue that AI governance should maximize innovation speed and also maximize precautionary control. Reconcile both into one operational governance mechanism.
